qualifier: feeding ether lipid and wax biosynthesis
name: Very long-chain acyl-CoA synthesis for ether lipids and waxes
rationale: All members build long/very long-chain acyl-CoAs by elongation or consume them to make plasmalogens, ether lipids and waxes; the ether/wax arm separates it from the linoleate/ALA confusable and the catabolic peroxisomal confusables.

qualifier: with ERK inactivation and negative feedback
name: Stress MAPK signalling to AP-1 with ERK negative feedback
rationale: Members cover TAK1-driven JNK/p38 activation, AP-1 activation and MAPK negative feedback/ERK inactivation; the feedback arm separates it from C1/C3, and JNK/AP-1 activation from the phosphatase-centred C4.

qualifier: progenitor division and radial glia-guided migration
name: Brain progenitor division and radial glia-guided neuronal migration
rationale: Members span forebrain/midbrain/cerebellar progenitor division, radial glia, cortical layering and neuronal migration; unlike confusables (spinal cord patterning, reelin/dendrites, dopaminergic or pituitary development) it centres on neural progenitor division and guided migration.

name: Common gamma-chain cytokine signalling in T and NK cells
rationale: Members are IL-2, IL-7, IL-9, IL-15 and IL-21 signalling plus T/NK cell differentiation and proliferation; confusables instead centre on beta-common (IL-3/IL-5), gp130/IL-6 and IL-10/IL-12 family cytokines.

name: Actin filament remodelling for lamellipodial protrusion and motility
rationale: Members regulate actin polymerization, capping, severing, crosslinking and leading-edge structures (lamellipodia, ruffles, pseudopodia, podosomes, macropinocytosis); confusables are Rho-family GTPase cycles or filopodia/EphB signalling rather than actin filament dynamics themselves.

core: Organelle acidification and cation gradient homeostasis
name: Organelle acidification and Na+/K+/H+ gradient homeostasis
rationale: Members cover V-ATPase acidification of lysosome, endosome, Golgi and synaptic vesicle lumens plus Na+/H+ exchangers and P-type ATPase Na+/K+ homeostasis; the cation-exchange arm separates it from phagosome, bicarbonate/anion and phosphate confusables.

name: Serotonin synthesis, secretion and reuptake
rationale: All members concern serotonin biosynthesis, secretion or uptake; confusables cover serotonin receptor signalling or MAO/COMT monoamine degradation and catecholamines.

qualifier: neutrophil lineage from myeloid progenitors via G-CSF
name: Neutrophil granulopoiesis from myeloid progenitors via G-CSF
rationale: Members are transcriptional and G-CSF-driven commitment of myeloid progenitors to neutrophils; confusables instead cover M-CSF/GM-CSF monocyte-macrophage, dendritic, eosinophil and mast cell differentiation.

name: ESCRT multivesicular body sorting and selective autophagy
rationale: Members cover ESCRT/MVB sorting, receptor downregulation, viral budding and exosomes together with selective autophagy and lysosome fusion; the autophagy arm separates it from ESCRT cytokinesis/nuclear envelope (C4), and ESCRT/MVB from endolysosomal fusion and protein quality control confusables.

qualifier: presynaptic active zone and postsynaptic receptor endosomal recycling
name: Presynaptic active zone and postsynaptic receptor endosomal recycling
rationale: Members combine presynaptic structure/vesicle clustering with endosome-mediated recycling of vesicles and neurotransmitter receptors; confusables cover AMPA-specific trafficking, clathrin-mediated vesicle endocytosis or Rab/ARF signalling.

name: Redox homeostasis and ROS/nitrosative stress detoxification
rationale: Members are responses to H2O2, hydroperoxide, NO and reactive nitrogen with ROS detoxification, HMOX1/BACH1 and MTF1 programmes; confusables emphasize ferroptosis/hypoxia, ROS production or oxidative-stress cell death.

qualifier: NT-3/TRKC with ERK5 and RIT/RIN-p38 arms
name: Neurotrophin-3 TRKC signalling via Ras-MAPK cascades
rationale: Members are NTF3-NTRK3 signalling and its Ras/FRS2/ARMS adaptors feeding ERK5, p38 and MAPK cascades; confusables are NGF/TRKA-centred with CREB and STAT3 outputs.

qualifier: downstream of insulin/IGF1 receptor and IRS
name: Insulin/IGF1 receptor IRS signalling activating PI3K-AKT
rationale: Members cover IRS/SHC/SOS adaptor events from IGF1R/insulin receptors leading to PI3K and AKT2 activation; confusables cover negative insulin regulation, ALK/LTK or MET/EPO receptor signalling.

name: Glycine and glyoxylate metabolism in amino acid catabolism
rationale: Members are general L-amino acid catabolism terms plus glyoxylate metabolism and glycine biosynthesis; the glycine/glyoxylate arm separates it from tyrosine, proline and threonine catabolism confusables.

name: Pinocytic uptake and onward early endosome cargo routing
rationale: Members regulate pinocytosis, cargo arrival at early endosomes and onward transport to late or recycling endosomes and transcytosis; confusables emphasize receptor recycling, macropinocytic ruffling or Golgi-endosome traffic.

qualifier: with hair cell stereocilia and mechanosensation
name: Eye and inner ear morphogenesis and sensory hair cell function
rationale: Members cover eye (lens, retina vasculature, cornea, iris) and inner/outer ear morphogenesis with hair cell stereocilia and hearing/balance; confusables are photoreceptor-centred retina or cranial nerve/olfactory development.

name: LDL-family receptor internalization and degradation controlling cholesterol uptake
rationale: Members regulate clathrin cargo recognition, internalization, recycling and lysosomal degradation of LDLR/VLDLR, limiting cholesterol import; confusables cover generic receptor surface localization, SREBP cholesterol synthesis or triglyceride-rich lipoprotein clearance.

qualifier: sperm chromatin condensation and protamine exchange
name: Male germline sperm chromatin condensation and protamine exchange
rationale: Members are Y-linked and spermatogonial genes with sperm DNA condensation, crotonylation and paternal protamine-nucleosome exchange; confusables cover piRNA silencing, maternal-zygotic transition or meiotic recombination.

name: Lipoprotein lipase-mediated chylomicron remodelling
rationale: All members concern LPL/LIPC lipase complex assembly and chylomicron remodelling; confusables cover lipoprotein assembly, clearance or LXR lipogenic regulation instead.

qualifier: with adherens junction remodelling in vessel formation
name: Endothelial fate specification and junction remodelling in vasculogenesis
rationale: Members cover arterial, venous and lymphatic endothelial differentiation, vasculogenesis and cadherin/adherens junction regulation; confusables are BMP/SMAD- and cardiac/pulmonary vessel-centred.

name: Naive and memory B cell surface signature
rationale: All members are B cell-enriched and surface-marker transcriptional modules; confusables are restricted to memory, naive, plasma cell or germinal centre/Tfh signatures.

qualifier: with hindbrain segmentation and axial mesoderm
name: Neural plate regionalization, hindbrain segmentation and axial mesoderm
rationale: Members cover neural plate and border specification, rhombomere/midbrain-hindbrain boundaries, dorsoventral axis and notochord/floor plate; confusables are somitogenesis, convergent extension, Hox clusters or spinal cord patterning.

name: CXCR4 and S1P receptor-guided lymphocyte migration
rationale: Members cover CXCL12-CXCR4 and S1P receptor signalling with Rac driving B/T cell chemotaxis and lymph node/marginal zone development; confusables centre on chemokine/dendritic cell trafficking, lymphocyte homing adhesion or GALT.

qualifier: transposon silencing by heterochromatin in germline
name: piRNA-guided transposon silencing in the germline
rationale: Members are piRNA biogenesis/processing, piRNA- and DNA methylation-directed heterochromatin silencing of retroelements and oocyte organization; confusables cover sperm chromatin, imprinting or maternal-zygotic transition.

name: Suppression of TLR2/TLR4-driven inflammatory cytokine production
rationale: Members negatively regulate TLR2/TLR4/LPS signalling and IL-6, IL-1beta and TNF production; the TLR/LPS arm separates it from confusables on IL-10/IL-12, T-cell or NF-kappaB regulation.
